description: This app's auto-renewable subscriptions in App Store Connect: product id, billing period and Apple review state. Use it to check that a paywall references a product that actually exists. Pass subscription_id to also fetch Apple's price ladder for that one product (Apple scopes price points per subscription, so there is no global list).

subscription_id.description: Also return price points for this subscription

name: list_store_products
title: List App Store subscription products
